classification: Visible isolated Electron comparison of an existing fine-fill implementation versus cost optimization, with exactly the same synthetic native PCM, fine/coarse stimuli and controls.
fixture: 24s 16kHz 16-bit mono silence;26coarse/fine units,first1000ms,500msstep,fine350ms,gap150ms. Full controls and350ms steady exclusion unchanged.
cold: Fresh Electron process, isolated unique profile and newly loaded Output document; OS/font/disk cache is not globally cleared.
warm: Same Electron/Output document first plays the identical source until 1.2s to prime fonts and line-fit, then pauses/seeks0 and clears only observation arrays before the original full playback protocol. Offset content change can legitimately remeasure.

short.classification: Untraced short first-glyph observations; separate from full controls/matched-onset matrix and all trace diagnostics.
short.fixture: Unchanged 24s 16kHz silent native PCM, 26 fine units at 500ms coarse intervals, first1000ms/end+350ms; each short run stops at native1.3s.
short.cold: New visible Electron process/profile/document; OS caches not forcibly flushed.
short.warm: Same Electron/document plays identical source to1.2s, pauses/seeks0 and clears only observation arrays before measuring.
limitations: Ten observations per warmth/variant are descriptive and do not prove population-wide latency.
First glyph is coarse onset emphasis observed by rAF; continuous fine paint is separately checked by pseudo clip and visible captures.
Media signed phase uses genuine local currentTime samples; Output interpolation and rAF frame quantization are retained, not subtracted.
Cold/warm samples are not pooled with trace or full control runs.
short.percentileMethod: Nearest rank: sorted finite values at ceil(n*p)-1. For n=10 p50 is the lower middle value and p95 is the maximum. Original p50/p95 remain unchanged; medianArithmetic separately averages the two middle values.

before.classification: Trace diagnostics only, grouped by warmth and actual timer/receive entry. Parent prepare/fit timings contain render work and must not be summed with nested render costs.
limitations: Warm trace explicitly excludes all product events before measurementStartedAt.
Cold/warm and timer/receive strata are reported separately; no forced entry or invented timing authority.
Trace-only wall costs may include descheduling and trace overhead, and do not replace untraced performance.

limitations: Warm trace explicitly excludes all product events before measurementStartedAt.

functional.classification: Visible real HTMLAudioElement diagnostics, separate from performance samples. CSS variable and computed pseudo-element clip are both observed. AX content alternative and pixel screenshots are supporting browser-specific evidence.
limitations: Focus does not render reading/ruby by its existing template design; ruby functional coverage is local.
rAF observations and captures add diagnostic workload and cannot be used as untraced performance samples.
Capacity is a bounded 20-glyph, 9-glyph-wide 3-row case, including four five-glyph model units; no arbitrary-script guarantee.
Trace diagnostics, short first-glyph samples and full controls are separate cohorts; none replace another.
All signed media and rate-adjusted wall distributions and maxima are retained.
Ten short and three full runs per warmth/variant remain bounded descriptive samples, not population guarantees.
rAF observations and cross-renderer adjacent native-sample interpolation are not hardware/display/OBS/audible synchronization.
No model timing accuracy, real-library flow or arbitrary script/template claim; synthetic library/source owners remain explicit.
Initial optimized trace/functional evidence is preserved separately and is not final performance evidence.
No additional native T2 visible fixture was run in this cost-only harness.
percentileMethod: Nearest rank: sorted finite values at ceil(n*p)-1. For n=10 p50 is the lower middle value and p95 is the maximum. Original p50/p95 remain unchanged; medianArithmetic separately averages the two middle values.
